title: Put a client on a follow-up rhythm

steps.caption: Home
steps.narration: Some clients need a regular check-in. A follow-up rhythm reminds you when it is time.

steps.caption: Due for follow-up
steps.narration: On Home, under Needs attention, Due for follow-up lists who to contact today.

steps.caption: Done
steps.narration: After you have been in touch, choose Done.

steps.caption: Logged under Activity
steps.narration: The follow-up is logged under Activity, and the client leaves the list.

steps.caption: Follow-ups
steps.narration: To see everyone on a rhythm, choose Follow-ups.

steps.caption: Next due
steps.narration: This client stays on a weekly rhythm. The next date has moved on a week.

steps.caption: Add a client
steps.narration: To add someone, search for the client.

steps.caption: Imani Brewster
steps.narration: Choose their name. A new client starts on weekly.

steps.caption: Biweekly
steps.narration: Change it to Biweekly for a check-in every two weeks.

steps.caption: Open the list
steps.narration: When a client no longer needs it, open their list.

steps.caption: Off
steps.narration: And choose Off. They are taken off the rhythm.

steps.caption: Close
steps.narration: Close the window. Whoever comes due next shows up under Needs attention.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Follow-ups are on Home, at the top of the left menu.

youtube.title: How to set a follow-up rhythm for a client | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Keep in touch with clients on a weekly or biweekly rhythm in the ConstructHUB CRM. See who is due today on Home, mark a follow-up Done, add a client to a rhythm, change it, and take a client off. Recorded in a demo workspace with made-up clients.
